selection: first passing pair in the frozen lexicographic order; all have equal view count
merge: filter original pre-NMS pool to views 0 and the pair, then original classwise NMS IoU strictly greater than 0.5, original stable sort, truncate600, original raw-ignore, no refill
sequence_diagnostic: post-ignore correct-class geometric coverage at IoU0.50/0.75 by native COCO size ranges; no one-to-one claim, AP or selector; all sequences retained including zero-GT; gained/lost relative to C
